preconditions.description: S is a non-empty string with length between 1 and 10^5.
K is an integer between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in S)
preconditions.description: All characters in S are lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 if len(set(S)) < K else max((j - i + 1 for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i, len(S)) if len(set(S[i:j+1])) == K), default=-1)
postconditions.description: Returns -1 if the total number of unique characters in S is less than K; otherwise, returns the maximum length of any substring of S containing exactly K unique characters.
